MP Court Acquits 11 in 2022 Khargone Violence Case

A Madhya Pradesh court acquitted 11 Muslim men accused in the 2022 Khargone communal violence case. The court cited a lack of substantive evidence and investigative lapses in the prosecution's case. The violence occurred during Ram Navami celebrations in 2022. The acquittal follows a trial where the prosecution's case reportedly collapsed. The specific charges against the acquitted men were related to the communal violence.
